text:
Situation: Paclitaxel has been on FDA's shortage list since 2021-10-05 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 61 months. Corvale East holds 21 vials of 6 mg/mL 50 mL (6 days on hand) and 74 vials of 6 mg/mL 16.7 mL (32.6 days). Corvale General holds 81 vials of 6 mg/mL (26.1 days) and 71 vials of 6 mg/mL (25.1 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 7 vials of 6 mg/mL 50 mL (9.2 days). Our Corvale sites use NDC 25021025550 labeled by Sagent Pharmaceuticals (label set 5721b9bf) which names plant GLAND with operations listed as sponsor only.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows paclitaxel first posted 2021-10-05 and still listed as of 2026-10-21. An alternate manufacturer, Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, operates a registered plant (FEI 3014866088) that received a VAI classification on 2024-03-08 per FDA inspection 1232189.

Our position: Current inventory at Corvale East is critically low for the 50 mL presentation. Corvale General has sufficient supply to support internal transfers while maintaining two weeks' stock. Abraxis BioScience, LLC is not on FDA's shortage list today and represents a viable purchase option.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 29 vials of 6 mg/mL 50 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval (transfer request).
2. Transfer 4 vials of 6 mg/mL 50 mL from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director approval (transfer request).
3. Purchase paclitaxel from Abraxis BioScience, LLC — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: Purchasing from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. or American Regent, Inc. at this time because their labels name no plant we could place.
